clauses.quote: Special use of sick leave will be reviewed by the principal, the Benefits Department, and granted by the appropriate Assistant Superintendent, in the event of serious illness of a member of the immediate family, or of any other person who is a member of the same household as the teacher.
clauses.notes: Granting of special sick leave for family illness.

clauses.quote: Denial of special use of sick leave can be appealed to the Superintendent.
clauses.subject_text: Denial of special use of sick leave
clauses.notes: Appeal right for teachers regarding leave denial.

clauses.quote: Verification may be required for any family illness for which special use of sick leave is requested.
clauses.notes: Management's discretion to require proof of illness.

clauses.quote: After three days of absence for family illness in any one school year, the teacher shall furnish verification of any family illness for which special use of sick leave is requested.
clauses.notes: Duty of teacher to provide proof after three days.

clauses.quote: After ten days of absence for family illness in any one school year, the teacher involved shall pay the cost of substitutes for any further use of special sick leave that is granted, by an Assistant Superintendent, for family illness.
clauses.notes: Financial responsibility of teacher for extended family illness leave.

clauses.quote: (The teacher shall be charged the current daily Substitute B rate.)
clauses.notes: Specifies exact daily deduction rate for substitute costs.

clauses.quote: Up to five (5) days of special use of sick leave will be granted by the principal in the event of a death in the immediate family as defined above.
clauses.subject_text: Up to five (5) days of special use of sick leave

clauses.quote: Bereavement days can be taken within a two-week window from the time of the death.
clauses.notes: Discretionary timing for using bereavement days.

clauses.quote: Teachers are allocated four (4) personal leave days each contract year.
clauses.notes: Annual allocation of personal leave days.

clauses.quote: Personal leave can be taken for any reason, at the discretion of the teacher.
Teachers who take no personal leave in a contract year will receive an amount equal to three times the current Substitute B rate.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take no personal leave in a contract year
clauses.notes: Payout for unused personal leave days.

clauses.quote: Teachers who take one personal leave day in a contract year will receive an amount equal to two times the current Substitute B rate
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who take one personal leave day in a contract year
clauses.notes: Payout for partial personal leave usage.
